title: EMARS: Event-based Motion-Aware Correction, Deblurring and Interpolation of Rolling Shutter Images
titleJa: EMARS：イベントデータを用いたローリングシャッター補正・ブレ除去・フレーム補間
descriptionJa:
イベントデータと時間条件付き光フローを用い、ローリングシャッター歪み補正、ブレ除去、任意倍率フレーム補間を統一的に扱う研究。IEEE ICIP 2026にて発表予定。
A flow-centric event-based framework for joint rolling-shutter correction, deblurring, and arbitrary-rate frame interpolation. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2026.
descriptionEn: A flow-centric event-based framework for joint rolling-shutter correction, deblurring, and arbitrary-rate frame interpolation. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2026.

title: AI System Web Application
descriptionJa:
ローリングシャッター画像とイベントデータを入力し、歪みのない高フレームレート画像と動画を生成する研究モデル推論Webアプリ。
An inference web application that fuses rolling-shutter images and event data to generate distortion-free high-frame-rate images and videos.
descriptionEn: An inference web application that fuses rolling-shutter images and event data to generate distortion-free high-frame-rate images and videos.

title: AI Expense Agent
descriptionJa:
自然言語で家計を記録し、カテゴリ分類、月次統計、予算管理、月末予測、支出比較、節約提案を行うTool-based Agent。
A tool-based personal-finance agent for natural-language transaction recording, analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and spending advice.
descriptionEn: A tool-based personal-finance agent for natural-language transaction recording, analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and spending advice.

title: Era SNS Web Application
descriptionJa:
年齢層別Safe Zoneの実現を目指し、本人確認、プロフィール、投稿、フォロー、管理者審査などのSNS基盤を実装したWebアプリ。
An SNS foundation with identity verification, profiles, posting, following, and administrator review, designed toward future age-aware Safe Zones.
descriptionEn: An SNS foundation with identity verification, profiles, posting, following, and administrator review, designed toward future age-aware Safe Zones.
